jules: Quick sync — are we still on track for OptKit deliverables this sprint? Need clarity on who owns quant recs -> integration + QA timeline.

sam: I'm owning the quant rec PRs. PR 5234 is open but needs perf regression sign-off. Pinged @maria for the QA checklist. :eyes:

maria: Got it. Can we land quant profiles by Wed so QA can run stability suite Thu? If regressions, we'll file a test-gap issue.

sam: Wed is tight but doable if tony finishes batch/caching shim by EOD Tue. tony, status?

tony: On it. Batch shim PR 5240 — just one behavioral test failing (`kv_cache` edge-case). Debugging now. If I don't fix by noon tomorrow, I'll push a temporary fallback hook.

anya: FYI I noticed a small perf regression on 1k-token sequences in staging with q4_0.2 — logging a regression alert: GH issue 783. Might be related to cache eviction timing.

sam: Thanks @anya — can you paste the failing traces? Also, @infra-bot can you snapshot the staging pods for the timeline 2026-03-15T22:00Z?

infra-bot: Snapshot request accepted — captured pod logs: s3://redwood-logs/staging/optkit/2026-03-15/22-00.tar.gz

maria: I'll queue the stability suite after we get the updated quant profiles. If regressions persist, propose we roll forward with fallback + ticket for root cause.

jules: Fine. Owners: quant profiles -> @sam; batch shim & fallback -> @tony; QA/stability -> @maria; infra snapshots -> infra-bot. Milestone target: profiles merged by 2026-03-18 23:59 UTC. If any blockers before EOD Tues, call it out here.

tony: Noted. Will push fallback PR if tests stall.

sam: PR 5234 updated with perf numbers + benchmark script (see `bench/q4_profiles/run.sh`). Link: https://git.redwood/repo/optkit/pull/5234

anya: I'll run a focused 1k-token perf job tomorrow morning and post results.

jules: Thanks. If someone needs pairing time to clear the kv_cache test, ping me and I'll schedule 30m.

maria: I'll take a look at the stability infra tomorrow after the 9am sync. Thanks all :thumbsup:
